step.title: Mount the gate controller box (placeholder)
step.text: Placeholder: the GC0.1 box sits behind the lower rail at the lower-left corner and stays below the diffuser top edge, so nothing reaches into the opening. Heat-set two M3S inserts into the free lower-face pilots of the lower-left corner (x = 21 and 36 mm) before building the frame, then tip the gate back or fit the box before lowering the gate into the feet, and screw the flange on from below. The corner itself is unchanged. Box geometry, wiring and power are not designed yet.
